race.description: Warwick Classic Defending Champ Greg Cook Hcp (C2)
race.comment: SNUGG (9) was below her best when finishing fifth at Beaudesert last start, but she is a talented mare with plenty of upside, and her fast-finishing second fresh up at Dalby is the best guide to use. If the tempo is genuine, then she can have the last say here. BOLE LE (4) resumed from a spell with a game third over 1200m at Toowoomba 10 days ago, and he should be reaching peak fitness now. Bubba Tilley picks up the ride, and he can take this out. HEAVENLY LOVE (5) resumes from a spell and she will don the blinkers here for the first time. Follow any positive market moves. ROMANTIC BUBBLE (2) was too strong when winning at Rockhampton last time out over 1200m, and the extra 150m here won't be a problem. This is not much harder, and with Ash Butler in the saddle from a good gate, he can win again.
